<!-- pr-reviewer: 12848ffc17904b058d95d2faa1c647fe29afebb1 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Two one-line data changes (lathe Z `-615..615`, mill-turn Z `-620..620`) apply the same program-coordinate convention as #477 (#457); X stays a centreline band, Y was already symmetric. No checker code changed.
- Consistent with #477: it touches none of the same files (`vmc.mch`, `tilthead.mch`, `machine/mod.rs`, `AGENTS.md` vs. `lathe.mch`, `millturn.mch`). A trial merge of this branch with #477's head merges automatically, so they do not conflict in either merge order. Convention text lives in #477, as the body says.
- New `lathe_stroke.rs` pins both directions (a face-and-turn job posts; a clearance of L+20 still refuses by name) plus the X band. Provenance and gate-map header present, file is 182 lines. The decision file `docs/decisions/493-lathe-z-stroke.md` is in place, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #493`.
- No build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes; no golden/snapshot changes.

**Local results (merged with current main, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | ok |
| lathe_stroke 5, lathe_post 7, lathe_post_g76 5, lathe_post_refusals 5, lathe_field_sim 6, lathe_field_tools 2, lathe_spindle_fit 3, lathe_spindle_keyed 6, lathe_spindle_law 8, lathe_cross_drill 5 | all pass |
| turning 5, turning_profile 6, turning_bore 11, turning_holder 8, turning_blade 14, turning_contour 10, turning_contour_stock 3, turning_form 8, turning_thread 8, turning_axial_rapids 3, turning_stock_approach 3, turning_insert_zone 5 | all pass |
| drill_prior 12, drill_prior_kinds 4, drilling_axial 7, c_axis_live 4, coolant_followups 7, conformance 6, machine 32, machine_library 11, posting 17, setup_mount 6 | all pass |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The Mill-turn X `0..650` still refuses live-tool milling on the -X side of centre; the PR flags this as a maintainer decision. I agree it is out of scope here.
- The ui crate suites were not run (ui untouched; the PR author says none reads the stroke).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
